collection.description: An elder who cannot sleep looks up at the stars, the same stars they watched as a child.

setup.name: The moment
setup.text: (name1) can't sleep, so (he/she) sits outside and looks up. The stars are out, all of them, thick as sand. And it strikes (him/her) that they're exactly the same stars (he/she) looked at as a child, lying on this same beach. Everything else has changed. The huts have been rebuilt a dozen times. The people (he/she) grew up with are old now, or gone. (His/Her) own face would surprise (his/her) younger self. But the stars are in just the same places, doing just the same slow turn across the sky. (name1) isn't sure whether that's a comfort or just a fact. (He/She) watches them until (he/she) gets sleepy, then goes back inside, leaving them to it.
